verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figures for the H200, with or without precision or sparsity stated. It offers only relative marketing multipliers (e.g., 1.9X Llama2 70B, 1.6X GPT-3 175B, 110X vs CPUs) plus memory capacity and bandwidth, which do not support sizing from tensor throughput. Tensor throughput is a core axis for a data-center GPU, so the verdict is none rather than na.
